title: Terms & Privacy
subtitle: Guidelines and policies regarding your use of Faceless Income Studio products.
body:
## Terms of Service

Welcome to Faceless Income Studio. By purchasing or using any digital product, guide, template, or resource from this site, you agree to the following terms. All products sold are for personal or single business use only, unless otherwise stated on the product page. You may not resell, redistribute, or share purchased files with others. Due to the digital nature of these products, all sales are final and non-refundable once a file has been downloaded, except where required by law. Faceless Income Studio reserves the right to update pricing, product availability, and site content at any time without prior notice. Any guides or strategies shared are for educational purposes only and do not guarantee specific income results, as outcomes depend on individual effort and circumstances.

## Privacy Policy

Faceless Income Studio respects your privacy. When you make a purchase or contact us through this site, we may collect basic information such as your name, email address, and payment details, processed securely through our payment provider. This information is used only to deliver your purchase, respond to inquiries, and occasionally send updates if you've opted in to receive them. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. Payment processing is handled entirely by our third party payment provider, and we do not store your card details on this site. By using this site, you consent to this policy. If you have questions about your data, you can reach out through the contact page.
